sql_statement:
WITH bom_line AS (
    SELECT
          BV.[BOMID] AS [Parent Number]
        , BV.[ITEMID] AS [Line Part]
        , BV.[BOMQTY] AS [BOM Lines Qty]
        , BV.[OPRNUM] AS [Oper. Num.]
        , BV.[UNITID] AS [UOM]
        , BV.[DATAAREAID]
        , BVV.NAME
        , BVV.FROMDATE
        , BVV.TODATE
        , BVV.FROMQTY
        , CASE
            WHEN BVV.ACTIVE = 0 THEN 'No'
            WHEN BVV.ACTIVE = 1 THEN 'Yes'
          END AS [ACTIVE]
        , BVV.RECID
        , IV.[Item Group ID] AS [Item Group ID]
        , H.PERSONNELNUMBER AS [APPROVER]
        , BT.[SITEID] AS [Site]
        , CASE
            WHEN BT.[APPROVED] = 0 THEN 'No'
            WHEN BT.[APPROVED] = 1 THEN 'Yes'
          END AS [APPROVED]
        , IV.[Item Name] AS [Product Name]
        , H.[Employee Name] AS [Approver Name]
        , CASE
            WHEN BV.BOMQTYSERIE = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE BV.BOMQTY / BV.BOMQTYSERIE
          END AS [Conversion Factor]
        , BV.BOMQTYSERIE AS [Per series]
        , IV.[Item Type Description]
    FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IV
    LEFT JOIN BOM_V BV
        ON BV.ITEMID = IV.[Item ID]
       AND BV.DATAAREAID = IV.Company
    LEFT JOIN BOMVERSION_V BVV
        ON BV.BOMID = BVV.BOMID
       AND BVV.DATAAREAID = BV.DATAAREAID
    LEFT JOIN BOMTABLE_V BT
        ON BV.BOMID = BT.BOMID
       AND BT.DATAAREAID = BV.DATAAREAID
    LEFT JOIN HCMWORKER_V H
        ON H.RECID = BT.APPROVER
    WHERE IV.Company = 'rdsi'
      AND BV.ITEMID IS NOT NULL
      AND BVV.ACTIVE = 1
      AND (BVV.TODATE IS NULL OR BVV.TODATE >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) OR BVV.TODATE = '')
),

commoditycode AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
          [INTRACODE]
        , ITEMID
    FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[INVENTTABLE_V]
    WHERE [DATAAREAID] = 'rdsi'
)

SELECT *
FROM bom_line a
LEFT JOIN commoditycode b
ON a.[Line Part] = b.ITEMID
complexity: High (2 CTEs, 5-way join with LEFT JOINs, CASE logic, date filters)
description: Extracts complete Bill of Materials structure from Dynamics AX, joining BOM master, versions, approval details, and commodity codes. Includes active BOM versions only, with effective date ranges and approver information.

complexity: Low (single table query with company filter)
description: Core item master data from Dynamics AX. Includes product classifications, ABC segmentation, supply strategy, shelf life, UOM, and primary vendor assignment. Filtered to company 'rdsi' with non-null item names.

sql_statement:
WITH Base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        i.[Item ID],
        i.[Delivery Date],
        i.[Vendor Account],
        v.[Name] AS [Vendor Name]
    FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Purchase Order Transactions_V] i
    INNER JOIN [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Vendor_R] v
        ON v.[No] = i.[Vendor Account]
    WHERE i.[Vendor Account] IS NOT NULL
),
RankedVendors AS (
    SELECT
        [Item ID],
        [Delivery Date],
        [Vendor Account],
        [Vendor Name],
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY [Item ID]
            ORDER BY [Delivery Date] DESC, [Vendor Account]
        ) AS rn
    FROM Base
    WHERE [Delivery Date] IS NOT NULL
),
LatestVendor AS (
    SELECT
        [Item ID],
        [Vendor Account] AS [Latest Vendor Account],
        [Vendor Name] AS [Latest Vendor Name]
    FROM RankedVendors
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT distinct
    b.[Item ID],
    lv.[Latest Vendor Account],
    lv.[Latest Vendor Name],
    b.[Vendor Account],
    b.[Vendor Name]
FROM Base b
LEFT JOIN LatestVendor lv
    ON b.[Item ID] = lv.[Item ID]
ORDER BY b.[Item ID] DESC
complexity: Medium (3-level CTE with ROW_NUMBER window function, ranking, and LEFT JOIN)
description: Vendor history and current supplier data. Uses window function to rank vendors by most recent delivery date, then returns all historical vendors plus the current (most recent) vendor per item.

sql_statement:
WITH Item_V AS (
    SELECT
        IV.[Item ID]
        , IV.[Item Group ID] AS [Item Group ID]
        , IV.[Item Name] AS [Product Name]
        , IV.[Item Type Description]
        , IV.[Supply Strategy Code]
        , IV.[Vendor]
    FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Item_V] IV
    WHERE IV.Company = 'rdsi'
),

commoditycode AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
          [INTRACODE]
        , ITEMID
    FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[INVENTTABLE_V]
    WHERE [DATAAREAID] = 'rdsi'
)

SELECT *
FROM Item_V a
LEFT JOIN commoditycode b
ON a.[Item ID] = b.ITEMID
complexity: Low (2 CTEs with simple LEFT JOIN)
description: Item master data enriched with commodity classification codes (intracode). Used for tariff/HS coding, regulatory compliance, and procurement categorization.
External item ID mapping for customers/vendors. Maps internal item IDs to external catalog reference numbers and ABC categories for cross-reference and classification.

      ,[Delivery Name]
      ,[Item ID]
  FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[InvoiceTable]
  WHERE Company = 'rdsi'
description: Invoice line items linking items to customer accounts and delivery locations. Provides transactional data for invoice analysis and order-to-cash reporting.
